g.text: Composition circles: area scales with source grid-cell count; sectors show threat-class shares.
7,215 occupied 0.25 degree cells; highest source threat per original cell. WRI Reefs at Risk Revisited 2011.
Grouping is for legibility. Symbol areas are not reef area, threatened hectares or current reef condition.
Solid izzi-hue colours. Blank: no mapped source cell. All memberships and class counts are retained.
